title: Collect a granule sample with a bottom-discharge probe
instruction: Use the closing sampling probe to collect at least 5 grams of granules from the tub into the sample jar. Leave the probe supported, the sample contained, and both hands released.
context: Incoming-material quality control: admit granules into a closed sampling chamber at depth, withdraw the retained sample, and discharge through a separate bottom opening into a jar.
setup: Standard calibrated bimanual YAM station with parallel grippers, table top z=0.7475 m, overview and two wrist cameras. Original upright 300 mm sampler: 280 g aluminum frame with rubber support grip and 3 mm clear polycarbonate inspection wall; 70 g blue intake assembly; 65 g orange discharge assembly. Chamber 54×54×54 mm, side gate 50 mm +Z travel, bottom slide 58 mm −X travel. Support grasp (−10,70,255) mm; blue tab (−50,−80,220) mm; orange tab (−105,−80,130) mm. Source: fixed polymer tub, 105×105 mm inside, 145 mm walls, 3 mm thick, at (0.43,0.02,0.7475) m. Material: 1,960 polymer spheres, 6.8 mm diameter, 0.18 g each, reset in a 14×14×10 lattice at 7.1 mm pitch then settled. Jar: fixed polymer cup, 110×110 mm inside, 95 mm walls, 3 mm thick, at (0.35,0.15,0.7475) m. Probe origin (0.43,0.38,0.7535) m in a polymer cradle with 116×116×6 mm foot, 30 mm walls and 100 mm opening. Secondary polymer tray: 520×620 mm inside, 50 mm walls, 8 mm base, centred at (0.40,0.16) m. README.md, setup-layout.json and scene-inventory.json give every solid, nominal material and transform.
scoring: 0.4 for ≥2 g and <5 g eligible sample at rest in the jar; 0.7 for ≥5 g. Grains must enter the open side port from the source, remain enclosed with both shutters ≤2 mm open, then exit through the uncovered bottom. Holding a full sampler over or inside the jar earns no delivery. Full 1.0 additionally requires all chamber corners inside the 100 mm cradle opening (+0.5 mm tolerance), origin within 5 mm of support height, upright cosine >0.98, both shutters ≤2 mm, probe speeds <15 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s, both grippers >40 mm open, and all robot collision bodies >3 mm clear, for 1 s. Granules below tabletop−5 mm, a probe outside the declared work area, or nonfinite state permanently score 0. README.md defines all bounds and whole-grain tests.
reset_notes: Restore fixed geometry and 1,960 individual grains, zero GateSlide and BottomSlide, initialize READY/open grippers, then settle 2.5 seconds. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Original enlarged granule sampler with separate side intake and bottom discharge. Both use native rigid contacts and constant passive springs: intake 25 N/m with 20 mm preload; bottom 20 N/m with 50 mm preload. The three rubber grips use nominal static/dynamic friction 1.20/1.00. There are 1,960 separate 6.8 mm polymer spheres with continuous collision detection. A real colliding clear-polycarbonate wall permits chamber inspection. The sample enters laterally while buried and falls vertically through the bottom into the jar. Primary manufacturer references motivate the operating principle; the geometry is original.
scores: Scripted native demo: 1.0, with 18.72 g eligible sample delivered in 2,355 actions (117.75 seconds); all captured grains delivered, none remain inside. Matching Dream-1 pending.
